why: Drops `ownerPalette` from the retired-parameter list, the state before issue #1100 removed the flag. Exit Developer Mode on an old #1057 evidence URL then leaves `?ownerPalette=` behind -- a URL still carrying developer state, which `developerExitSearch`'s own doc forbids -- and `canonicalDevSearch` carries it into canonical URLs as an unrelated parameter. Every other case in both files injects its own list, so only the cases that read the shipped default can see it.
killedBy: canonicalDevSearch retires stockCue by default, the first developer parameter removed for good (issue #1022)
canonicalDevSearch retires ownerPalette by default, the flag the Player colors setting replaced (issue #1100)
developerExitSearch drops ownerPalette with the shipped list, the flag issue #1100 removed
